title_home: Part-time work limits & schedule check for international students
foot_disc: Not legal advice and not a final decision. Rules can change.
foot_priv: Everything stays on this device (localStorage). No alien registration or passport numbers are collected. No server, analytics or web fonts.
final: Not a final decision · Confirm with your international office, HiKorea or 1345
mt_banner: Machine translation. Native review needed. Key sentences also show Korean.
err_save: Storage is full, could not save.
sigd_ok: Restaurants, cafés, convenience stores, office help, etc. You still need a permit before working.
sigd_ban: Construction, delivery (parcel, rider) and adult entertainment: in principle deportation or departure order regardless of how many times caught (from {from}).
sigd_restricted: Special-type work (designated drivers etc.), dispatch, subcontract, brokering and E-2 language teaching cannot be permitted for students.
sigd_conditional: Allowed only as an exception. Check the conditions with your international office.
sigd_mfg_ok: Manufacturing is allowed as an exception with Korean level 4+. A compliance form is required.
sigd_mfg_low: Manufacturing is not permitted below Korean level 4.
sigd_unknown: Could not classify by keyword. Show the business registration type to your international office.
sigl_ban: Construction, delivery (parcel, riders), adult entertainment (bars, karaoke, etc.)
sigl_restricted: Special-type work, dispatch/subcontract/brokering, professional fields (E-1–E-7, language teaching), long-distance work
sigl_conditional: Manufacturing (level 4+), English kids-café helpers, seasonal work and other exceptions
sigl_ok: Simple jobs students usually do: restaurant, café, convenience store, office help, interpreting
hero_line: Answer 6 questions to see your part-time hour limit. Add your shifts to see hours left this week and risky-job warnings.
hero_local: Data stays on this device only. No alien registration or passport numbers.
unl_on: Weekends, holidays, vacation: no hour limit
one_strike: Illegal work in construction, delivery or adult entertainment: deportation in principle regardless of count (from {from})
why_steps: ① 6 questions → ② limit card → ③ shifts → ④ weekly meter & warnings → ⑤ application dates .ics & employer card
q_date: Enter a date or choose 'Don't know'.
q2_d4: Calculated as language training. Press Next.
q3_skip: Year does not matter for this program. Press Next.
q4: Do you have Korean proficiency proof?
q4_sub: Choose one — the highest you have.
q4_thesis: Thesis students are calculated at 30 hours a week. Press Next.
lt_english_s: TOEFL 530, iBT 71, IELTS 5.5, CEFR B2, TEPS 601, etc.
q5: Do you qualify for the bonus (+5 weekday hours)?
q5_sub: Only if you meet the Korean requirement. Choose all that apply.
q5_thesis: No bonus for thesis students. Press Next.
q5_notmet: No bonus without meeting the Korean requirement. Press Next.
bonus_auto: TOPIK 5+ or KIIP stage 5 (final pass) → Korean-excellence bonus applied
b_gradeA: Last semester average A or higher
q6_d4_sub: You can apply 6 months after the status change date (or entry date with a visa).
entry_date: D-4 change date or entry date
attendance: Average attendance of all terms (%) — optional
q6_gpa_sub: Below C (2.0) may be restricted. You can leave it empty.
d4_need_date: Enter your D-4 start date to calculate
d4_after: Once eligible: {n} hours a week (incl. weekends & vacation).
notmet_why: You do not meet the Korean requirement (TOPIK {lv} or equivalent), so one weekly total limit applies including weekends and vacation.
thesis_note: Thesis students: 30 hours a week; the unlimited weekend/holiday/vacation rule does not apply.
d4_note: For D-4, weekends and vacation count toward the limit. 1 workplace, permit up to 6 months.
school_diff: May differ by school: expired TOPIK, certified university, long-distance rule
unk_lang: Korean proof unknown → treated as not met
unk_entryDate: D-4 start unknown → treated as not yet
vac_unl: No hour limit during vacation, but workplace count, job rules and permit dates still apply.
vac_lim: The same weekly limit applies during vacation (weekends & vacation included).
empty_p: Add a workplace and your work days/times to see hours left this week.
no_cap: You cannot work yet in this period.
sug_move: Week {week}: move {dow} {from}–{to} ({h}h) to {toDow} ({toType}) to stay within the limit.
sug_move_part: Week {week}: move {dow} {from}–{to} ({h}h) to {toDow} ({toType}) and also cut the rest.
sug_cut: Week {week}: cut {h} hours to stay within the limit.
wd_over: Going over the limit breaks your permit conditions. See the suggestions.
wd_places: More workplaces than allowed at the same time.
wd_d4wait: Before 6 months you cannot get a part-time permit.
wd_noPermit: Do not start work before you get the permit.
wd_beforePermit: Working before the permit date is illegal work.
wd_afterPermit: After the permit ends you need a new permit.
w_permitLong: {wp}: permit period entered is longer than {n} months
wd_permitLong: Check the dates on your permit.
w_permitHours: {wp}: over the hours on your permit {mins}h / {cap}h (week of {week})
wd_permitHours: Work only within the hours written on your permit.
w_changeNewPermit: {wp}: a new employer needs a new permit first (changed {date})
wd_changeNewPermit: The MOJ manual says a new permit is required in advance when the workplace changes to a different employer.
wd_changeReport: Gov24 says report a change within 15 days. This differs from the manual (new permit), so ask your international office.
w_commute: {wp}: {min} min commute — long-distance work may be restricted
wd_commute: School guides say 1 hour or more from home may count as long-distance.
wd_indBan: From {from}, construction, delivery and adult entertainment mean deportation or departure order in principle, regardless of count.
wd_indRestricted: This job cannot be permitted as student part-time work.
wd_indMfgLow: Manufacturing is allowed only with Korean level 4 or higher.
wd_indConditional: Check the exception conditions with your international office.
w_indUnknown: {wp}: job type could not be classified
wd_indUnknown: Check the business registration type with your international office.
wd_gpa: Below C (2.0) you may be restricted because study and work are hard to combine.
wd_attendance: Language courses are restricted below 90% average attendance.
w_topikExpired: TOPIK expired ({date}) — this school does not accept expired scores
wd_topikExpired: You may need a valid score report.
w_topikExpiredUnknown: TOPIK expired ({date}) — check your school's rule
wd_topikExpiredUnknown: Some schools accept it, some don't.
w_unknown_lang: You chose 'Don't know' for Korean proof
wd_unknown_lang: Calculated as not met (lower). Check your score report.
w_unknown_entryDate: You chose 'Don't know' for the D-4 start
wd_unknown_entryDate: Shown as 'not yet' until you enter a date.
w_holidayRange: Some dates are outside the holiday data
vac_dates_p: Enter vacation dates from your school calendar. The app does not invent vacation dates.
vac_err: Enter valid start and end dates.
wp_permitted: I have a part-time permit for this workplace
changed_help: The manual (new permit needed for a new employer) and Gov24 (report within 15 days) differ. We show both.
idnum_block: Numbers that look like alien registration or passport numbers are not saved.
places_block: You can work at up to {max} workplaces at the same time.
del_wp_p: Its shifts will also be deleted.
paste_err: Could not read. Example: Mon 18-22, Sat 10-18
midnight_note: If the end is earlier than the start, the shift crosses midnight and is split.
no_work_before: Do not start work before your permit is issued
ics_note: All-day events with a reminder 1 day before. Past items are skipped.
tl_empty: Enter a work start date or change date to create a timeline.
lead_note: {a} days before start: ask your international office (common university advice, needs checking); {b} days before: apply on HiKorea (usual processing 10 days).
ev_ask: {wp}: ask international office for the confirmation form
ev_report: {wp}: change report deadline (Gov24 guide, needs checking)
change_conflict: MOJ manual (2026-11-16): a new employer needs a new permit in advance. Gov24: report the change within {d} days. They differ — ask your international office.
pw_p: The file or printout contains your name, workplace, shifts and visa details. Show it only to people you trust and don't leave it on shared computers.
rules_asof: As of {d} · MOJ stay-permit manual by status
tbl_note: Bonus (+5): Korean requirement met + certified university, or last semester average A+, or TOPIK 5 / KIIP stage 5 (final pass).
d4_tbl_note: ? on D-4 values: the manual's hour table has no D-4 row, so the Study in Korea table is used (needs checking). D-4 includes weekends and vacation.
pen_1: Working without a permit: 1st (minor) fine notice then stay allowed; 2nd forced departure
pen_2: Breaking permit conditions: 1st strict warning; 2nd no part-time work for the rest of study; 3rd student status cancelled
pen_3: Caught in construction/delivery/adult entertainment: deportation or departure order in principle regardless of count (from 2026-11-09)
pen_4: Immigration Act Art. 94: up to 3 years prison or 30 million won fine (unpermitted activity, hiring without status)
diff_1: Expired TOPIK accepted (Yonsei yes / Hallym no)
juhyu_yes: 15+ hours/week → weekly holiday pay applies (approx. {w} won/week)
juhyu_no: Under 15 hours/week → no weekly holiday pay
wage_note: Reference only. Weekly holiday pay = (weekly hours ÷ 40) × 8 × hourly wage (40-hour cap). Confirm exact amounts with the Ministry of Employment and Labor.
tr_p: Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified) and Uzbek (Latin) are machine-translated and not yet reviewed by native speakers.
emp_p: Made in Korean. Only your initials, not your name.
off_h: One page for the international office
off_p: Your profile, limit, 5 weeks of shifts and 3 questions on one A4 page.
bk_p: Save or restore this device's data as a JSON file. Nothing goes into the URL.
rs_p: The data on this device will be replaced by the backup.
rs_err_format: This is not a backup from this app.
rs_err_idnum: It contains something that looks like an ID number, so it was not restored.
wipe_btn: Delete all data on this device
wipe_p1: Your answers, workplaces and shifts will all be deleted.
wipe_p2: This cannot be undone. Back up first if needed.
